Three standout finds: [arstechnica-home](/websites/arstechnica-home/) ships FOUR reader-selectable layouts (Classic/Grid/List/Neutron star) for the same articles — one appearance styled several ways, picked by the reader instead of a breakpoint, exactly the owner's framing. [figma-home](/websites/figma-home/)'s showcase carousel is deliberately 2872px of cards inside a 1920px viewport (drag-to-scroll on purpose, not a grid that failed to wrap). [kubernetes-docs-home](/websites/kubernetes-docs-home/)'s two side rails grow as a PERCENTAGE of the viewport instead of a fixed measurement, unlike every other docs site in this corpus.
